after_canonical.evidence_source: Previously validated specialist and trained scene/crop evidence for exactly this photo, wording and observations.

interpretation: The original signed parking-surface map on the tree photo supplies zero candidate regions after current vehicles are excluded. Its clarification is reproducible without a language call. A new positive-control garage request still required the trained model, timed out once, and subsequently got a blocked verdict from two genuine scene calls. The known double doors case asked for clarification on a staging server without prepared specialist evidence and recovered its previously verified pin on the canonical server. These tests check behavior and latency. The independent automatic-accuracy test remains the eight-photo frontage scorecard.
